column1: see|/siː/|v.|看见；理解|基础|see|see the difference::看出区别;see clearly::看清楚|I can see a small boat on the lake.::我能看见湖上有一条小船。|Now I see why you made that choice.::现在我明白你为什么做出那个选择。
look|/lʊk/|v.|看；看起来|基础|look|look at::看;look for::寻找|Look at the clouds above the mountain.::看看山上方的云。|You look much more relaxed today.::你今天看起来放松多了。
notice|/ˈnoʊtɪs/|v.|注意到；察觉|基础|notice|notice a change::注意到变化;take notice of::留意|Did you notice the new sign by the door?::你注意到门旁的新标志了吗？|I noticed that the room had become quiet.::我察觉到房间已经安静下来。

observe|/əbˈzɜːrv/|v.|观察；注意到；遵守|基础|observe|observe a change::观察变化;observe the rules::遵守规则|We observe the birds without getting too close.::我们在不过分靠近的情况下观察鸟类。|All visitors must observe the safety rules.::所有访客都必须遵守安全规则。

observation|/ˌɑːbzərˈveɪʃən/|n.|观察；观察结果|四级|observe|careful observation::仔细观察;make an observation::作出观察|Careful observation helped her identify the problem.::仔细观察帮助她发现了问题。|His observation about the pattern was useful.::他对这一规律的观察结果很有用。

observer|/əbˈzɜːrvər/|n.|观察者；旁观者|四级|observe|an independent observer::独立观察员;a careful observer::细心的观察者|An independent observer attended the public meeting.::一位独立观察员出席了公开会议。|A careful observer can spot small differences.::细心的观察者能够发现细微差别。
inspect|/ɪnˈspekt/|v.|检查；检验|基础|spect|inspect the equipment::检查设备;inspect closely::仔细检查|The engineer came to inspect the bridge.::工程师来检查这座桥。|Please inspect the package before accepting it.::请在签收前检查包裹。

inspection|/ɪnˈspekʃən/|n.|检查；检验|四级|spect|a safety inspection::安全检查;regular inspection::定期检查|The building passed its annual safety inspection.::这栋建筑通过了年度安全检查。|Regular inspection can prevent expensive repairs.::定期检查可以避免昂贵的维修。

perceive|/pərˈsiːv/|v.|察觉；将某事看作|四级|perceive|perceive a difference::察觉差别;perceive something as::将某事看作|She could perceive a slight change in his voice.::她能察觉到他声音中的细微变化。|People may perceive the same event differently.::人们可能以不同方式看待同一事件。

perception|/pərˈsepʃən/|n.|感知；看法；认识|六级|perceive|public perception::公众看法;change one's perception::改变某人的看法|Travel can change our perception of other cultures.::旅行可以改变我们对其他文化的看法。|Our perception of time varies with the situation.::我们对时间的感知会随情境变化。

perspective|/pərˈspektɪv/|n.|视角；观点|四级|spect|a different perspective::不同的视角;from my perspective::在我看来|Try to see the problem from her perspective.::试着从她的视角看待这个问题。|The discussion gave us a different perspective.::这次讨论给了我们不同的视角。
aspect|/ˈæspekt/|n.|方面；层面|基础|spect|an important aspect::重要方面;every aspect of::各个方面|Cost is only one aspect of the decision.::成本只是这一决策的一个方面。|We discussed every aspect of the new plan.::我们讨论了新计划的各个方面。

prospect|/ˈprɑːspekt/|n.|前景；可能性|四级|spect|career prospects::职业前景;the prospect of::某事发生的可能性|The course may improve your career prospects.::这门课程可能改善你的职业前景。|We were excited by the prospect of working together.::想到有望一起工作，我们很兴奋。

suspect|/səˈspekt/|v.|怀疑；猜想|基础|spect|suspect that::怀疑;suspect a problem::怀疑有问题|I suspect that the answer is simpler than we think.::我猜答案比我们想的更简单。|The team began to suspect a technical problem.::团队开始怀疑存在技术问题。

respect|/rɪˈspekt/|n. v.|尊重；敬重|基础|spect|show respect for::表示尊重;respect a decision::尊重决定|We should show respect for different opinions.::我们应该尊重不同意见。|I respect your decision even though I disagree.::即使我不赞同，我也尊重你的决定。
think|/θɪŋk/|v.|思考；认为|基础|think|think about::思考;think carefully::仔细想|Take a moment to think about your answer.::花一点时间思考你的答案。|I think we should try a different approach.::我认为我们应该尝试另一种方法。
thought|/θɔːt/|n.|想法；思考|基础|think|give thought to::考虑;after some thought::经过一番思考|A new thought came to me on the train.::在火车上，我想到了一个新点子。|We need to give more thought to the details.::我们需要对细节作更多考虑。

consider|/kənˈsɪdər/|v.|考虑；认为|基础|consider|consider an option::考虑一种选择;consider carefully::仔细考虑|Please consider all the options before deciding.::请在决定之前考虑所有选项。|We consider her a reliable member of the team.::我们认为她是团队中可靠的一员。

reconsider|/ˌriːkənˈsɪdər/|v.|重新考虑|扩展|consider|reconsider a decision::重新考虑决定;reconsider a plan::重新考虑计划|The new evidence made us reconsider our decision.::新证据让我们重新考虑了决定。|You may want to reconsider the timing.::你可能需要重新考虑时机。

reflect|/rɪˈflekt/|v.|反映；反射；认真思考|基础|reflect|reflect on::认真思考;reflect a change::反映变化|The calm water reflects the evening sky.::平静的水面映着傍晚的天空。|Take some time to reflect on what you learned.::花些时间认真想想你学到的东西。

reflection|/rɪˈflekʃən/|n.|映像；反映；深思|四级|reflect|a reflection of::某事的反映;on reflection::经过考虑|The report is a reflection of the team's efforts.::这份报告反映了团队的努力。|On reflection, I decided to accept the offer.::经过考虑，我决定接受这一提议。

analyze|/ˈænəlaɪz/|v.|分析；研究|基础|analyze|analyze the data::分析数据;analyze a problem::分析问题|We need to analyze the data before drawing conclusions.::我们需要先分析数据，再下结论。|The students learned to analyze a short poem.::学生们学习了如何分析一首短诗。

analysis|/əˈnæləsɪs/|n.|分析；分析结果|基础|analyze|data analysis::数据分析;an analysis of::对某事的分析|Her analysis revealed an unexpected pattern.::她的分析揭示了一种意想不到的规律。|The report includes an analysis of the main risks.::报告包含对主要风险的分析。

assume|/əˈsuːm/|v.|假定；以为；承担|基础|assume|assume that::假定;assume responsibility::承担责任|Do not assume that everyone knows the rules.::不要以为所有人都知道规则。|She will assume responsibility for the new project.::她将承担新项目的责任。

assumption|/əˈsʌmpʃən/|n.|假定；假设|基础|assume|a basic assumption::基本假设;question an assumption::质疑假设|The plan is based on a reasonable assumption.::这个计划基于一个合理假设。|Good research often begins by questioning an assumption.::好的研究常从质疑一个假设开始。
infer|/ɪnˈfɜːr/|v.|推断；推论|四级|infer|infer from::从某事推断;infer a meaning::推断含义|We can infer the meaning from the context.::我们可以根据上下文推断含义。|What can you infer from these results?::你能从这些结果中推断出什么？

inference|/ˈɪnfərəns/|n.|推断；推论|六级|infer|draw an inference::作出推断;a logical inference::合乎逻辑的推论|The evidence supports a different inference.::这些证据支持另一种推论。|You should explain how you reached that inference.::你应该解释自己如何得出那一推论。

reason|/ˈriːzən/|n. v.|原因；理由；推理|基础|reason|a reason for::某事的原因;reason carefully::认真推理|There is a good reason for the delay.::这次延迟有充分的原因。|We must reason carefully from the available facts.::我们必须根据现有事实认真推理。

reasonable|/ˈriːzənəbəl/|adj.|合理的；通情达理的|基础|reason|a reasonable price::合理的价格;a reasonable explanation::合理的解释|The hotel offers clean rooms at a reasonable price.::这家酒店以合理价格提供干净的房间。|That seems like a reasonable explanation.::那似乎是一个合理的解释。

evidence|/ˈevɪdəns/|n.|证据；根据|基础|independent|clear evidence::明确的证据;evidence of::某事的证据|We need clear evidence to support the claim.::我们需要明确的证据来支持这一说法。|There is little evidence of a lasting change.::几乎没有证据表明发生了持久的变化。
